themeDescription: Double UPI charges, surge fee disputes & bank settlement delays

challenges.title: Double deduction on Google Pay for 10-minute order
challenges.shortDescription: De-escalate an anxious customer whose bank account was debited ₹640 twice due to a payment gateway timeout.
challenges.mission: Verify gateway RRN number, reassure customer with clear RBI reversal timeline, and credit instant app wallet balance if requested.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Your app crashed while processing my payment, but ₹640 got deducted twice from my HDFC bank account! I only received one order. Where is my other ₹640?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting their money safely back into their bank

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Fears having been scammed by app glitch.
hiddenObjectives: Confirm 1st order active and 2nd transaction auto-voided
possibleSolutions: Provide official bank reversal UTR number
Offer instant app wallet credit if they don't want to wait for bank
unacceptablePromises: Do not claim instant bank account deposit if inter-bank NEFT/IMPS takes hours.

challenges.title: Dispute over unannounced rain surge delivery fee
challenges.shortDescription: Explain sudden ₹45 bad-weather delivery partner surcharge on a midnight order.
challenges.mission: Transparently explain rider safety incentive during monsoon downpour while preserving customer trust.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Why is there an extra ₹45 added to my bill as 'Rain Surge'? It is barely drizzling outside! This is pure price gouging.

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: fair pricing and knowing where the extra money goes

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Argues that competitors don't charge surge right now.
hiddenObjectives: Explain 100% surge pass-through to hard-working delivery partners
Offer one-time waiver if first-time user
unacceptablePromises: Do not say company pockets the delivery surge fees.
